# stringifyJson

<link-summary>Serialises a value to JSON with the object keys in a fixed order.</link-summary>

<web-summary>stringifyJson() — Serialises a value to JSON with the object keys in a fixed order. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>json</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function stringifyJson(value: unknown): string;
```

`JSON.stringify` writes keys in insertion order, so two objects that carry the same data can produce different text. Here the keys of every object are sorted, which makes the output a stable key — for a cache, a checksum or a comparison.

It is what `hashCode` hashes, and the reason two equal objects hash alike.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description             |
| :-------- | :-------- | :---------------------- |
| `value`   | `unknown` | The value to serialise. |

## Returns

`string` — the JSON text, with object keys sorted.

## Examples

### Serialising

```javascript
stringifyJson({ b: 1, a: 2 }); // => "{\"a\":2,\"b\":1}"
stringifyJson([1, "a", null]); // => "[1,\"a\",null]"
```
